summary: .goreleaser.yaml's brews.repository.owner must be the printer's GitHub handle and homepage must point at the printing-press-library repo, matching every sibling CLI's release config; an empty owner breaks Homebrew tap publication and produces an invalid double-slash homepage URL.
reason: This CLI's .goreleaser.yaml was emitted with an empty repository.owner and homepage "https://github.com//forkable-pp-cli" — confirmed against 4 sibling food-and-dining CLIs (anylist, cookunity, dominos, wolt), all of which have owner: <printer-handle> and homepage: https://github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library. The stale read-only brews.description (predating the meal-management write surface) was also updated to match the current root Short/README subtitle.
validated_outcome: python3 yaml.safe_load confirms valid YAML with owner: enlewof and the corrected homepage.
